# Migration folders that have been applied to a shared database (production).
# One line per folder:   <folder> sha256:<hex>      Blank lines and # comments are ignored.
#
# NEVER rename, edit or delete a folder listed here. The database remembers each
# migration by name and checksum: a renamed folder is a migration that "was never
# applied", and `prisma migrate deploy` stops with P3009 (the 2026-10-19 incident,
# docs/DEPLOYMENT-INCIDENT-2026-10-19.md).
#
# The hash pins the SQL itself, so an edit - or a file truncated by accident, as it_tickets
# was on 2026-10-19 - fails the lint. It is taken with CRLF read as LF, so a Windows checkout and
# the Linux CI agree; every other byte counts. A line WITHOUT a hash is refused on purpose: it
# would be a released migration that nothing protects, and the protection would decay unnoticed.
#
# To release a migration, after it has been deployed (not before: until then it may still be
# fixed in place, and it is still judged by the review rules of scripts/lint-migrations.mjs):
#     node scripts/lint-migrations.mjs --hash <folder>
# and paste the line it prints below. A folder that is not listed must have a timestamp LATER
# than the last one that is. Adding a line here freezes the migration AND stops the review rules
# from judging it, so a change to this file is reviewed with care.
